title: I made a multiplayer idle tycoon that runs in your browser — grow from 3 pots to a city-wide empire and fight other gangs for districts (alpha, free)
author: AKCeifador
selftext:
Hey! I'm a small indie studio and I just opened the alpha of Ganja Empire, a multiplayer idle/tycoon game that runs straight in the browser, with no download and no sign-up.



You start with 3 pots in a backyard shed and grow into a city-wide operation:



\- Hire workers who plant, harvest and sell on their own while you expand

\- Build a lab and fuse your best harvests into ★1–★6 lots

\- Real multiplayer: player market, auctions, trades, and visiting friends live

\- Join a gang and fight other gangs for districts on a weekly conquest map

\- Day/night cycle and a living pixel-art 3D city



A few things I care about:

\- No ads, ever

\- VIP is optional and a one-time payment, with no subscription

\- 10 languages

\- You can export your save and move it to another browser



It's in alpha, so honest feedback helps a lot. I'm especially curious about:

1. Were the first 10 minutes clear? Where did you get stuck?

2. Did it run smoothly on your device (PC/phone)?

3. What would make you come back tomorrow?



Play: [https://play.reapermoonstudio.com](https://play.reapermoonstudio.com)



I'll be in the comments all day. Thanks for trying it!



(It's a work of fiction, 16+.)
